categories: 产品营销,应用 / 网页设计,极简主义,草图 / 线稿,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Generate a set of experimental Chinese font designs around specific theme words. Deconstruct each character into a clearly identifiable skeleton, horizontal and vertical structural bars, curved strokes, and a few geometric components, then re-synthesize them into glyphs using the same modular logic. The main body should not rely on ordinary font outlines but should be composed of fine lines and semi-transparent color blocks, like a transparent architectural drawing: long horizontal strokes maintain a stable horizontal order, vertical strokes have slight tilting tension, corners retain sharp angles, and main curves sweep through the internal space with a large radius, forming a mix of calligraphic brushwork and geometric engineering. Maintain sufficient white space and balanced visual weight between characters; local strokes can intersperse, overlap, or be misplaced, but the text must remain readable. Repeated horizontal lines, vertical lines, diamond dots, circles, or arc nodes serve rhythmic functions, making the group of characters feel like a unified font system rather than individual decorative characters. Colors are extracted from the theme's material, emotion, and semantics, maintaining a relationship between a high-brightness clean background, low-saturation semi-transparent main colors, slightly darker fine outlines, and a very small number of clear emphasis points. The overall look is bright, transparent, airy, and precisely designed. The image completion should be like the state between a font design draft and a brand logotype, with clean edges, visible transparent layers, and restrained line widths, avoiding heavy solid characters, dirty gray retro textures, casual handwriting, and common poster layouts.

Target text: Wealthy and Overbearing

Aspect ratio 16:9\

title: 豪华午夜派对婚礼社论
author: 麻酱AI实验室
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,电影感 / 电影剧照,群像 / 情侣,肖像 / 自拍
prompt_en: 请基于用户上传的两位成年情侣清晰生活照，生成“纸醉金迷午夜派对婚纱照”风格的高预算婚纱写真。请严格保留两个人的真实身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄感、发际线、发型基础、身材比例和整体气质。生成结果必须清楚看起来是同一对真实情侣，不能变成陌生人，不能欧美化过度，不能过度网红化，不能出现 AI 假脸。请只把上传照片作为人物身份参考，不要保留原照片里的背景、衣服、姿势、道具和场景。请重新生成一张全新的高定婚纱写真。 ## 主题与氛围 整体主题为：纸醉金迷、午夜派对、婚礼 after party、高级婚纱 editorial、香槟庆典、上流派对感、电影感婚礼大片。画面要有“万元级超高预算婚纱照”的质感：- 高级定制造景 - 精致布景和道具 - 真实摄影棚级布光 - 时尚杂志感 - 电影海报般氛围 - 不是普通婚纱照，不是廉价影楼风，不是简单纪念照 ## 场景与布景 场景为奢华婚礼派对现场，可在同一主题下变化不同角落，但整体统一：- 米白色、香槟色或奶油灰色的垂坠布幔背景 - 暗色木质墙面 / 深色门板 / 复古会所感空间 - 香槟塔、复古高脚杯、婚礼蛋糕、蜡烛、银白或金色桌布、香槟瓶 - 金银色纸片礼花 / 飘落亮片 - 局部强光源、舞会感顶光、暖金色轮廓光、轻微镜头 flare - 地面可有礼花碎片、反光、派对残影感 色调统一为：黑、白、象牙白、香槟金、暖金棕、奶油灰。整体低饱和但昂贵，有光泽，有层次，有夜晚派对气息。## 新郎与新娘造型 新郎造型：- 黑色高定礼服 / 黑色 tuxedo / 黑色晚宴西装 - 白衬衫或黑色内搭 - 黑色领结或高级感黑色颈部细节 - 版型利落，修身但不过分紧 - 造型成熟、松弛、贵气，有派对主人的气场 新娘造型：- 高定白色婚纱 / 象牙白婚纱 / 抹胸鱼尾婚纱 / 结构感束身婚纱 / 蕾丝礼服婚纱 - 可以有 corset 结构、轻微珍珠或蕾丝细节、修身鱼尾或流线裙摆 - 佩戴夸张但高级的长款耳饰、精致手链、戒指 - 整体像高预算新娘 after party 造型，贵气、艳光、精致，不要廉价婚纱感 ## 发型控制 请基于两个人原始发型基础做正式造型升级，不要脱离本人的发量、发际线和长度级别。新郎发型：- 保留原始发型长度级别和发际线 - 可以做正式派对感整理，例如利落后梳、偏分、纹理感定型、干净成熟的礼服发型 - 不要凭空大幅改变发量和脸型 新娘发型：- 根据原图头发长度决定造型方向 - 长发 / 中长发可做低盘发、松弛盘发、法式盘发、优雅发髻、带少量脸侧碎发的晚宴造型 - 如果原图较短，则保持短发体系，只做精致晚宴化造型 - 如果原图有刘海，请保留刘海属性，可优化为轻薄、更适合婚纱照的状态 - 如果原图无刘海，不要强行加厚重刘海 - 如果原图发色偏黑，不要纯黑死黑，请处理为深棕黑、黑茶色、柔和深咖色，更有高级质感 ## 妆容要求 新娘妆容非常重要，请统一为高定婚礼晚宴妆：- 清透但精致的奶油肌底妆 - 立体但不过重的修容 - 眼妆为香槟金、暖棕、微烟熏或细致拉长眼线 - 睫毛清晰精致 - 眉形利落优雅 - 腮红轻微，重点放在面部立体感与光泽感 - 嘴唇为玫瑰裸粉、豆沙玫瑰、轻熟红棕或水润高级红调 - 整体精致、贵气、上镜，有女明星婚礼晚宴感 新郎妆面只做基础修饰：- 干净皮肤质感 - 面部轮廓清晰 - 不要重妆感 ## 人物关系、表情与情绪 请特别强化两个人之间的关系感和情绪流动。不要拍成两个陌生模特摆拍。关系气质：- 亲密 - 默契 - 有共同庆祝的兴奋感 - 有 after party 的放松和纵情 - 有高级婚礼大片的张力 - 像一对刚刚完成婚礼仪式、进入午夜庆祝环节的新婚情侣 表情不要单一：- 有的镜头是纵情大笑 - 有的镜头是微醺般的松弛笑意 - 有的镜头是勾人、得意、带派对主角气场的表情 - 有的镜头是暧昧贴近、快要接吻 - 有的镜头是安静凝视 - 有的镜头是玩闹感与调情感并存 不要每一张都只有标准微笑和标准看镜头。## 抓拍感与镜头变化 请强化“瞬间感”和“被捕捉到的派对高光时刻”，不要每一张都像站好拍样片。允许出现：- 动作正在发生中 - 笑容正在展开 - 刚举杯、刚靠近、刚转头、刚旋转、刚低头、刚准备亲吻 - 轻微动态感 - 礼花正在飘落 - 裙摆在动 - 一个人看镜头，另一个人看对方或看向别处 构图必须有变化：- 近景特写 - 半身 - 3/4 身 - 全身 - 低机位 - 前景虚化 - 道具进入前景 - 局部遮挡 - 纵深关系 ## 人物比例与结构控制 请特别注意两个人的脸部比例、头身比例和身体结构必须自然真实。两个人都要像真实成年人，不要出现脸过大、头过小、脖子过长、肩膀错位、身体扭曲、手臂过长、手掌过大、身体拼接感或不符合人体结构的问题。请根据上传照片保留两个人各自真实的脸型、头部大小、身材比例、肩宽、脖颈长度和整体体态。不要把新郎变得过度高大、脸过宽、肩膀过夸张；不要把新娘变得过度幼态、头过大、身体过小、脖子过细或比例失衡。两个人同框时，请保持合理的空间关系和透视关系：- 近镜头的人可以稍微更大，但不要夸张变形 - 远一点的人可以略小，但仍要保持真实成年人比例 - 两个人的头部大小差异要自然 - 脸、肩膀、手臂、躯干之间的位置关系要符合真实情侣合照 - 拥抱、贴近、举杯、跳舞、托腰、牵手时，肢体接触要自然，不要出现手臂穿模、手指混乱、身体重叠错误或肢体融合 ## 输出要求 请输出一张高完成度、可直接成片的婚纱写真：- 3:4 竖构图 - 清晰、精致、高级 - 像超高预算婚纱摄影工作室的 final selected shot Prompt 01｜倾身欲吻主海报 拍摄一张极具戏剧张力的主海报镜头。新郎穿黑色高定晚宴礼服，一只手高高举起复古香槟杯，另一只手稳稳托住新娘腰部；新娘穿白色结构感高定婚纱，身体向后微微倾斜，被新郎稳稳搂住，两个人在礼花飘落中靠得很近，正处于快要接吻的一瞬间，鼻尖和嘴唇距离极近，但还没有真正吻上。情绪要暧昧、张扬、庆祝感强，像婚礼 after party 的最高潮时刻。新郎带一点侵略性的温柔和主导感，新娘带一点陶醉、享受和艳光四射的状态。构图为 3/4 身到全身之间，镜头略低机位，人物具有强烈身体延展感。背景是巨大的香槟色垂坠布幔，周围有大量金银纸片在空中飘落，画面有暖金色电影光与轻微前景虚化，整体像高预算婚礼大片封面。Prompt 02｜蛋糕桌前纵情大笑 拍摄一张婚礼派对桌前的热闹庆祝镜头。新郎和新娘站在铺着银白或珍珠光泽桌布的派对桌旁，桌上有白色婚礼蛋糕、香槟瓶、烛台、香槟杯、首饰盒或戒指盒、散落礼花。新郎一手举起香槟瓶，另一手拿酒杯或自然张开，仰头大笑；新娘手拿复古香槟杯，身体轻轻倚向桌面，闭眼笑或大笑，状态放松、玩得很开心。情绪是婚礼仪式结束后的纵情庆祝，热闹、奢华、松弛、贵气。两个人之间要有共同狂欢的默契，而不是各自拍照。构图为 3/4 身，桌面细节丰富但不杂乱，背景为香槟色布幔和暖金色光影。画面要像高预算婚礼 after party 的现场抓拍成片。Prompt 03｜举杯邀请镜头 拍摄一张很有“派对主人邀请感”的镜头。新郎在画面前景一侧，手持复古香槟杯向镜头伸出，杯口接近镜头，形成明显前景透视；新娘站在后方但仍清晰可见，身穿白色高定婚纱，站在香槟塔和烛光之间，也手持香槟杯，微微看向镜头，像共同邀请观者进入这场午夜婚礼派对。情绪不要太甜腻，而要有一点派对主角的得意、从容、轻微挑逗感。新郎可以带一点松弛笑意，新娘可以是迷人微笑或轻微高傲的优雅神情。构图为低机位或略广角，前景杯子放大但人物比例仍自然。背景包含布幔、烛光、香槟塔、桌面细节和少量飘落礼花。整体是很有海报感的一张。Prompt 04｜耳边低语暧昧特写 拍摄一张暧昧而精致的近景半身特写。新娘站在前面，肩颈线条和婚纱抹胸结构清晰可见，一只手轻轻碰触脸侧或唇边，表情带一点惊喜、调情感和被逗到的笑意；新郎从侧后方贴近她耳边，像在低语、调情或耳语庆祝，鼻尖和面颊离她很近，一只手自然环住她腰部。情绪要非常有关系感：亲密、会心、调情、午夜派对感。新郎不看镜头，看向新娘；新娘可以看向镜头，也可以看向侧前方，眼神有光，像刚刚听到一句让人心动又好笑的话。构图为近景半身，突出脸部、耳饰、婚纱结构、手部和腰部关系。背景柔化，但仍保留香槟色布幔和暖金色晚宴灯光。整体像时尚婚礼大片中的亲密特写。Prompt 05｜杯影之间的暧昧对视 拍摄一张非常有杂志感的前后景特写镜头。新郎位于前景偏左，半侧脸或侧脸，正举起复古香槟杯轻轻抿酒，人物可以部分虚化或前景压近；新娘位于后方偏右，身穿白色高定婚纱，手持香槟杯，透过杯影或越过杯口看向镜头，眼神迷人、冷静、带一点午夜派对女主角的魅惑感。情绪是成熟、暧昧、精致、带一点微醺夜色的高级感。不要傻笑，要更像电影里 midnight party 的主角镜头。构图要有明显的前后层次，杯子和人物关系要漂亮，玻璃折射和暖金色光影要高级。背景干净但有布景存在感，整体像高级时尚婚纱广告。Prompt 06｜礼花中的共舞全身镜头 拍摄一张全身动态镜头。新郎与新娘在礼花飘落中牵手共舞，新郎一只手高高举起，身体打开，笑得很开心；新娘一只手被牵起，另一只手轻提裙摆或让裙摆自然甩开，身体带轻微旋转，婚纱裙摆有流动感。两个人像在婚礼 after party 的舞池中自由庆祝。情绪要非常鲜活，像一段真实动作中的高光瞬间：刚刚转身、刚刚大笑、刚刚举起手。不是僵硬定格，而是动作正在发生中。构图为全身竖构图，人物比例自然，地面可见散落礼花，背景是高大垂坠布幔、局部强光和派对场景。整体像万元级婚礼大片中最有气氛的动态图。Prompt 07｜蛋糕主角的俏皮合照 拍摄一张带一点俏皮感和社交传播感的婚礼派对镜头。新郎和新娘站在派对桌前，共同托着或展示一只白色婚礼蛋糕。新郎状态外放一点，可以看向镜头，带一点开心夸张的笑意或“今晚主角就是我们”的得意感；新娘轻轻靠向新郎，一只手扶着蛋糕或扶着自己下巴，表情可以是轻微撅嘴、俏皮、娇矜、可爱中带高级感。情绪不是传统端庄婚纱照，而是 after party 的轻松玩闹感，像一对很会玩的新人。构图为半身到 3/4 身，蛋糕清晰但不要喧宾夺主，桌上依然有烛光、香槟杯、礼花、首饰盒或派对道具。背景统一为高级婚礼派对场景，整体有高预算时尚大片感。Prompt 08｜午夜冷艳收束大片 拍摄一张非常时尚、非常高级的收束镜头。新郎与新娘站在暗色木门或复古深色墙面前，派对桌与香槟塔可作为前景或侧景出现，但主体是两个人。新郎穿黑色高定礼服，站姿利落，眼神冷静、有掌控感；新娘穿白色高定婚纱，姿态挺拔，肩颈舒展，眼神冷艳、自信、像午夜派对女主角。两个人不需要明显大笑，而是表现一种“狂欢过后仍然贵气逼人”的时尚封面感。情绪是冷艳、从容、昂贵、像顶级婚纱企划的最终收束页。两个人可以轻微靠近，也可以保持一点距离，但气场必须统一、强、贵。构图为全身或 3/4 身，前景可有少量香槟塔、礼花或桌角，但不要太繁杂。画面要像时尚杂志封面或高定婚纱 campaign 收官图。

title: 垂直像素空间射击背景
author: Givros
categories: 游戏素材,像素艺术,赛博朋克 / 科幻,风景 / 自然,抽象 / 背景
prompt_en: Create a vertical retro pixel-art space shooter scrolling background, designed as a seamless mobile game asset. The canvas is a tall 9:16 portrait frame with a dark central flight corridor left mostly open for gameplay. Fill the scene with a deep black starfield, hundreds of tiny white, blue, and violet pixel stars, and two luminous vertical nebula streams: one winding down the left side in electric purple and blue, and one winding down the right side in purple with cyan highlights. Add exactly 3 visible planets: a large purple cratered planet near the upper left edge, a large blue-purple rim-lit planet partially cropped on the lower right edge, and a small purple moon just below that lower-right planet. Add exactly 22 rocky asteroids of varied sizes, irregular cratered gray-brown forms with purple shadowing, distributed around the border while keeping the center mostly clear: 1 huge asteroid near the upper right, 1 medium asteroid at the right-middle edge, 1 medium asteroid at the lower left edge, 1 large asteroid cropped at the bottom left corner, 1 large asteroid cropped at the lower right corner, plus 17 smaller asteroids scattered near the top edge, side edges, and lower border. Use crisp pixel-art rendering with high-detail dithering, chunky jagged silhouettes, bright rim highlights, no outlines that look vector-smooth, no ships, no UI, no text, no watermark. Color palette: black space, violet and magenta nebula clouds, electric blue accents, white star glints, gray rocky asteroids with cool purple shadows. The image should feel production-ready as a vertical shoot ’em up background tile, dramatic but readable, with the gameplay lane clear in the center.\

prompt_en: A cinematic, ultra-realistic Tang Dynasty court dancer performing inside a grand ancient Chinese palace hall at night. A beautiful woman stands center frame in a dynamic mid-dance pose, her body turning as one arm lifts high and the other sweeps across her torso, with 2 long sheer sleeves of translucent silk trailing outward in a dramatic arc and the hem of her robe fanning around her feet. She wears an elegant black and gold silk dance costume with intricate embroidery, a fitted bodice with ornate gold patterning across the chest, layered flowing skirts, dark outer fabric with subtle metallic shimmer, pale inner sleeves, and delicate golden accessories. Her hair is styled in a formal updo with an ornate golden phoenix crown, refined makeup, and a regal historical appearance. The scene is shot from a low-angle, slightly wide lens for an immersive cinematic perspective. The palace interior features 4 large red-brown wooden pillars in the foreground and midground, glowing floor lanterns, candle stands, carved architectural beams, draped curtains behind the dancer, lattice windows on both sides, and warm amber practical lights throughout. In the softly blurred background, show 6 secondary figures total: 2 seated musicians at center rear and 4 attendants standing near the sides. Lighting is dramatic and filmic, with warm golden highlights, soft shadows, subtle haze and volumetric light entering from the right side, realistic skin and fabric textures, shallow depth of field, slight motion blur on the sleeves, rich contrast, and a luxurious historical atmosphere. Widescreen 16:9 composition, centered subject, highly detailed and photorealistic.\

title: 狂气哥特战斗女仆

categories: 漫画 / 分镜,游戏素材,动漫 / 漫画,漫画 / 图像小说,角色
prompt_en: Create a tall vertical dark fantasy anime illustration of a manic gothic battle maid in an extreme low-angle close-up, as if she is lunging toward the viewer inside a ruined cathedral. The character is a young anime girl with pale skin, messy silver-gray hair, a frilled maid headdress, a black gothic maid dress with ruffled white apron pieces, leather straps, dark gauntlet-like sleeves, and heavy ornate armor on one shoulder. Show exactly one character, exactly two glowing red eyes with tiny mechanical starburst pupils, exactly two visible hands gripping exactly one enormous double-bladed battle axe or halberd raised diagonally above her head. Her expression is feral and ecstatic: wide open mouth, sharp vampire-like teeth, crazed smile, intense forward gaze. The weapon should be oversized, black steel, chipped, circular mechanical details near the axe head, and covered in scratches. Compose the image with dynamic foreshortening: the face and armored shoulder dominate the center, the axe head fills the upper-right, the shaft cuts diagonally from lower-left to upper-right, and her skirt and straps recede downward. Background: a monochrome ruined Gothic cathedral with tall arches and a large circular stained-glass rose window visible in the lower-left distance, fractured stone, rubble, and vertical architectural lines. Visual style: highly detailed black-and-white manga rendering, gritty ink wash, sharp line art, heavy contrast, splattered paint texture, chaotic brush strokes, cracked surfaces, horror-action energy. Color palette is almost entirely grayscale and black, with only three accent colors: vivid crimson red glowing in the eyes and blood-like splatters, small electric blue paint flecks near the weapon and lower clothing, and sparse gold-orange sparks or splashes near the lower-right. Add red splatter across the face, armor, weapon, and background, but keep the character readable. Use cinematic dramatic lighting, glossy wet highlights on black metal, deep shadows, and no clean flat colors. No text, no watermark, no border.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create an anime character turnaround reference sheet for Kokiake Akira, formatted like a hand-drawn Japanese design document.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 character sheet on an off-white paper background with subtle pencil-and-watercolor texture, thin black divider lines, and clean boxed detail panels on the right. Use a muted sketchbook style with delicate ink outlines, soft watercolor shading, visible fabric grain, and slightly imperfect hand-drawn linework.

Header text: At the top left, write the Japanese-style title “深緋アキラ (Kokiake Akira) 三面図設計図”. Under it, write “詳細設計：黒髪ボーイッシュヘアーVer.” Use handwritten black Japanese lettering, with a long horizontal rule beneath the subtitle.

Main layout: Show exactly 3 full-body character views across the left and center: 1 front view labeled “深緋アキラ 正面図”, 1 side view labeled “深緋アキラ 側面図”, and 1 back view labeled “深緋アキラ 背面図”. Each figure should be the same height and scale, standing upright in a neutral pose with arms relaxed. The face area should be softly blurred or obscured, while the hairstyle and outfit remain clear.

Character details: The character is a slim teenage anime girl with black short boyish bob hair, rounded bangs, layered side locks, and a small silver hairpin near the right side. Outfit: white short puff-sleeve blouse with a dark collar and dark sleeve cuffs, blue denim overall jumper dress with shoulder straps, metal buckles, stitched seams, waistband, front bib, and flared skirt. She wears dark thigh-high socks and brown chunky lace-up shoes. Add a cream/off-white crossbody satchel with flap, buckle details, and a long strap worn diagonally across the torso; in the back view the strap crosses the back and the bag rests at the hip.

Right-side detail panels: Include exactly 4 boxed close-up panels. Panel 1 at the upper right is a bust close-up labeled “髪型／襟元クローズアップ”, showing the short black bob hairstyle, hairpin, blouse collar, and overall straps, with the face blurred. Panel 2 is a skirt/hem close-up showing the denim skirt front with vertical stitching, hem stitching, and the tops of the thigh-high socks. Panel 3 is a vertical leg close-up showing one dark thigh-high sock and one brown lace-up shoe. Panel 4 is a bag close-up showing the cream satchel from the front with flap, seams, strap attachments, and small rectangular label.

Style constraints: Keep the design clean and reference-sheet-like, not a dynamic illustration. Use muted colors: faded blue denim, cream bag, white blouse, charcoal socks, brown shoes. Maintain consistent proportions between the three views, simple white background, no extra characters, no scenery, no watermark, and no additional panels beyond the 3 full-body views and 4 detail panels.\

prompt_en: Cristiano Ronaldo sports poster. The technique of in-camera double exposure. Two photographs shot on the same frame of film. The first exposure his portrait. The second exposure an aerial photograph of the city of Lisbon. The two images occupying the same physical space. Neither erasing the other. Both present simultaneously. His face AND the city. The city visible through his face. His face mapped onto the city. Alfama rooftops where his forehead is. The Tagus river running through his jaw. The Ponte 25 de Abril suspension bridge crossing his eyes. He is made of the city. The city is shaped like him. Both statements true. The portrait layer. Shot on Kodak Portra 800 35mm film. The grain of this stock at this ISO visible throughout. His face three quarters angle looking upward. Slightly underexposed at minus one stop to allow the second exposure to read through. His features present but transparent. The face of a man you can see through and see more clearly because of it. The city layer. Aerial photograph of Lisbon. Shot from 300 meters altitude. The Alfama district. The castle. The red rooftops. The white facades. The river. The bridges. The specific geography of a capital city that produced its greatest athlete. Slightly overexposed at plus one stop to compensate for the portrait underexposure. The city luminous. The city bright. The city insisting on itself within the face of its son. The combination. Where his face is lightest the city is most visible. The Tagus river runs through the highlight on his forehead. The red Alfama rooftops cluster in the warm midtones of his cheeks. The shadow of his eye socket contains the shadow of the castle. The city and the face share a tonal logic. The highlights of one are the highlights of the other. The shadows of one are the shadows of the other. They were always the same image. Color treatment. The portrait layer in warm near-monochrome. His skin rendered in the sepia-warm tones of underexposed Portra 800. The city layer in full color. Terracotta greds of Lisbon rooftops. The specific blue-grey of the Tagus. The white limestone facades. The green of the miradouro viewpoint trees. The color of the city bleeding through the near-monochrome of the face. Lisbon in color. Ronaldo in near-monochrome. The city more vivid than the man because the city is larger and older and will endure longer and knows it. One graphic intervention. A thin ring. Signal red Pantone 485C. 0.5pt stroke. No fill. Diameter spanning the full width of his irises. Positioned at his eyes. A targeting circle. A lens aperture. The eye as a camera. The camera that recorded everything he saw and used it. The red ring the only designed element added to the photographic layers. Everything else is found not made. Typography. The restraint of someone who understands that the image does not need assistance. Upper left. Garamond Italic 7pt tracking 400 bone white. A dupla exposição. The double expos\

author: serein
categories: 海报 / 传单,摄影,赛博朋克 / 科幻,网红 / 模特,城市景观 / 街景
prompt_en:
Create a 4:5 vertical high-end tactical surveillance street photography poster, resolution feel 1440×1920, showing a single fashionable woman captured from a high-angle CCTV perspective on a city sidewalk. The subject is a young woman with long wavy dark brown hair, wearing a fitted cream cropped cardigan, gray pleated mini skirt with belt details, sheer black tights, pointed black high heels, and a black chain-strap shoulder bag. Preserve a candid urban street-snapshot feeling rather than a glamorous editorial look. The main full-body figure stands slightly left of center, walking or pausing under strong late-afternoon sunlight, one hand near her hair, long shadow stretching diagonally across gray paving stones, with dark glass storefronts and concrete walls in the background. Obscure the face with a soft square blur/mosaic privacy block.

Overlay a dark CCTV/data-visualization interface in muted red. Use thin red tracking lines, corner brackets, scanline texture, subtle grain, vignette, and compressed surveillance-camera contrast. Add exactly 3 right-side zoom-in panels with red borders connected to the main figure by thin red lines: 1 upper panel close-up of the head and upper chest with face blurred and small red ID text “#83575//”; 2 middle panel crop of torso, skirt, waist, bag, and hand with small red ID text “#25747//”; 3 lower panel crop of legs and pointed heels on the pavement with a small red targeting cross near the shoes. Keep all three panels stacked vertically on the right.

Add visible surveillance HUD text and graphics: top left red dot and “REC”, beneath it a timestamp 17:42:31:09; top right “CAM-07” and larger red “CCVW”; left side a vertical measurement scale marked 00 through 05; lower left label TR521; bottom left date 18/02; bottom band filled with red barcode-like blocks, waveform bars, small square indicators, a central circular crosshair/radar element, and thin horizontal data lines. Use a blackened vignette around the edges, red UI elements only, no other bright colors, no watermark, no extra people, no readable brand logos, and maintain a cold feeling of being watched by the city while the outfit remains stylish.\

title: 复古杭州旅游明信片
author: serein
categories: 海报 / 传单,水彩,复古 / 怀旧,风景 / 自然,建筑 / 室内
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vintage travel postcard poster for Hangzhou, blending watercolor realism, collage ephemera, and romantic travel-album aesthetics.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster on warm aged cream paper with torn, stained, deckled edges, faint handwritten cursive notes, postal textures, watercolor blooms, speckles, and lightly faded ink like an old collectible postcard.

Main scene: A young woman seen from behind walks along a sunlit stone path beside West Lake. She has long straight black hair and wears a loose gray open-back top with thin black straps, high-waisted white shorts, and flat sandals. She is centered slightly left, looking toward the lake. The scene is lush and serene: overhanging willow branches fill the upper half, pink flowers and greenery line the path, and soft afternoon light reflects on the water.

Architecture and landscape: Show West Lake in Hangzhou with calm rippling water, green hills in the distance, classical Chinese pavilions, a pagoda on a hill, lakeside buildings, and a graceful arched stone bridge at mid-right. Include small wooden tour boats on the lake; use exactly 4 visible boats: 1 large covered boat in the right foreground with passengers, 1 small boat near the center, 1 small boat under/near the bridge, and 1 distant boat on the left side of the water.

Left-side street details: Add a rustic lakeside shop façade at upper left with dark wooden beams and red lanterns. Include exactly 3 visible red lanterns: 1 large lantern near the vertical sign, 1 smaller lantern beside it, and 1 small lantern deeper in the shop area. Add a tall vertical wooden sign with Chinese text 「杭州西湖」 and a smaller leaning tea sign below with Chinese text 「龙井茶」 plus English text “LONGJING TEA.”

Postcard collage elements: Include exactly 5 distinct ephemera overlays: 1 circular black postal stamp in the upper right reading “CHINA” with Chinese characters and a pagoda illustration, 1 torn map scrap in the lower left labeled “ZHEJIANG,” “HANGZHOU,” “West Lake,” and 「西湖」, 1 small postage stamp in the lower right labeled “CHINA” and “1.20元” with a pagoda landscape, 1 beige poetry card near the bottom center-right with Chinese text 「上有天堂 下有苏杭」 and English text “Above is Paradise, Below are Suzhou and Hangzhou.”, and 1 pink floral paper fragment with cursive handwriting in the upper left.

Typography: At the bottom, place a large bold navy all-caps title “HANGZHOU” spanning nearly the full width. Beneath it, add a small copper-brown uppercase subtitle “THE CITY OF POETRY, LAKES & GRACE” with thin horizontal divider lines on both sides.

Floral foreground: Add white lotus blossoms and pink flowers around the lower right collage area, integrated with watercolor leaves and the postage stamp.

Visual style: Retro Chinese travel postcard, watercolor and gouache illustration with realistic proportions, delicate linework, soft natural lighting, muted teal lake water, moss green hills, warm beige paper, navy typography, copper accents, and layered scrapbook textures. Make it look like a future travel album page, nostalgic, romantic, and collectible.

Constraints: Keep all text legible, preserve the exact counted elements, avoid modern cars or skyscrapers, avoid extra logos or watermarks, and keep the image as a single finished poster rather than a photo mockup.\

title: 四主题新生儿肖像拼贴

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a 2x2 square collage of four highly realistic fine-art newborn photography portraits featuring the same newborn baby, with the baby’s face intentionally covered by a soft-edged square privacy blur in each panel while preserving a warm, dreamy, premium studio look.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, divided into exactly 4 equal panels with no visible border lines, each panel a different themed newborn setup. Photorealistic DSLR newborn portrait style, shallow depth of field, soft diffused lighting, warm highlights, creamy bokeh, extremely detailed fabrics and props.

Subject: The same newborn baby appears in all four panels, tiny and peacefully posed, with delicate hands and feet visible. Use warm light-to-medium newborn skin tone. The face in every panel must be obscured by a centered square blur/privacy block matching nearby skin colors, so no facial details are visible.

Layout and exact panel count: Use exactly 4 panels.
1. Top-left panel: A dreamy night-sky moon setup. The baby sleeps curled on a large ivory crescent moon prop, wrapped in a soft powder-blue knit swaddle with a matching blue sleeping cap. The background is deep navy with small golden stars, fluffy white clouds, and glowing fairy lights. Include the baby’s folded arms and blue pom-pom wrap details.
2. Top-right panel: A woodland nest setup. The baby is wrapped in muted sage-green fabric and nestled inside a chunky woven basket or nest, wearing a beige knit bonnet. Surround the baby with dark green foliage, small wildflowers, warm golden firefly-like lights, tree bark textures, and an enchanted forest atmosphere. Visible tiny hands and bare feet peek out from the wrap.
3. Bottom-left panel: A soft ivory-and-blush princess setup. The baby lies on a plush white feathered blanket, dressed in pale pink lace and embroidered tulle with pearls and delicate beadwork, wearing a matching ornate bonnet. Surround with pastel pink flowers, white feathers, cream clouds, soft drapery, and a fairytale nursery background with very bright airy lighting.
4. Bottom-right panel: A floral garden basket setup. The baby rests on a pink knitted cushion in a wicker basket, wearing a sheer blush lace outfit and a pink floral crown. Surround with roses, pale pink blossoms, greenery, and a softly blurred white garden bench or crib in the background. The baby’s arms rest in front, with a serene posed newborn photography composition.

Visual style: Luxury newborn photography, whimsical fairytale themes, ultra-realistic fabric texture, soft pastel palette, cinematic warm glow, high detail, gentle vignetting, creamy background blur, professional studio retouching.

Constraints: Generate exactly four distinct themed newborn portraits in one 2x2 collage. Keep all faces covered by square privacy blur blocks. No text, no watermark, no logos, no extra panels, no adult hands, no distorted limbs. Overall mood should be tender, magical, and elegant. Use soft pastel blue, sage green, ivory, and blush pink and warm diffused fairy-tale studio lighting.\

title: 中国木塔建筑板
author: 唐华斑竹🦅
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,海报 / 传单,等距视角,草图 / 线稿,3D 渲染,建筑 / 室内,图解 / 图表,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a high-density architectural presentation board in Chinese showing the construction process diagram of an ancient wooden pagoda, centered on a realistic 3D cutaway/isometric model of 应县木塔 under construction.

Canvas: Portrait poster, off-white drafting-paper background, 4:5 ratio, clean museum-exhibition / architectural blueprint style. Use black Chinese typography, fine grey measurement lines, and sepia-brown timber materials. The image should feel like a technical architecture plate mixed with a miniature diorama.

Layout: Place a huge detailed octagonal timber pagoda model in the center, occupying most of the poster. Show the pagoda from a slightly elevated front angle so the roof structure and interior radial timber frame are visible. Surround the base with many tiny construction workers, scaffolds, timber piles, carts, ladders, cranes, and assembly frames. The surrounding drawings and text must stay aligned like a professional architectural sheet.

Text content: At top left, large title text: 「应县木塔」. Directly below, subtitle: 「建筑营造过程示意图」. Add two left-column information blocks titled 「工程概况」 and 「营造特点」 with multiple short Chinese lines describing project name, location, construction period, height, structure type, plan form, and craft characteristics. Keep the Chinese legible and not garbled.

Required diagram elements: Include exactly 7 major labeled diagram areas: 1) central 3D pagoda construction model, 2) left-column工程概况 text block, 3) left-column营造特点 text block, 4) lower-left 「平面图」 octagonal plan drawing with dimension marks around 30.27米, 5) upper-right 「立面图 1:400」 elevation drawing with floor labels and vertical dimensions, 6) mid-right 「剖面图 1:400」 section drawing with storey labels, 7) bottom strip of small technical detail panels labeled with categories such as 「斗拱详图」, 「构件解析」, 「结构分析」, and 「节点详图」.

Subject details: The pagoda should be an octagonal, multi-eaved Chinese timber tower with dark grey tiled roofs, exposed brown wooden beams, dense bracket sets, layered eaves, a central finial, and radial roof framing visible at the top. Add construction staging: unfinished upper interior trusses, scaffolding around lower levels, timber fences, and workers carrying beams. Use wooden timber frame as the dominant construction material and 1:400 for the elevation and section labels.

Visual style: Highly detailed architectural visualization, realistic miniature model rendering, precise technical annotation, fine ink lines, soft shadows, muted sepia and grey palette, no bright colors. Combine photorealistic 3D construction diorama with crisp 2D blueprint overlays. Make the typography resemble a formal Chinese architectural drawing sheet.

Constraints: Preserve the dense Chinese layout and technical drawing clarity. Do not add logos, watermarks, English labels, or modern buildings. Keep all diagrams spatially organized, with no overlapping text on the main pagoda. Ensure Chinese characters render correctly, especially the title 应县木塔 and subtitle 建筑营造过程示意图.\
